dogecoin.text: Not sure why, but there are hundreds of thousands of dollars of value being traded between bit coin and dogecoin. What does it meeeaaaan?
Dogecoin works a little like a derivative of bitcoin. People trade doge for bit and vice versa. Bit can then be converted to USD.

@ChauDave While dogecoin does look like a bubble, it doesn’t trade on fundamentals whatsoever because there are none. The same as all crypto. So with no fundamentals, to what level does the bubble pop when it eventually does? 0 or some other number? Or does it never pop?
